title: 第25章 放火第26章 上榜与藏锋
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
;;
冯远庞大的身躯轰然倒塌，溅起一地的血水与泥浆。
他那双至死都圆睁的眼睛里，凝固着无法理解的震骇与绝望。堂堂半步先天、威震赤铁矿十余年的土皇帝，就这么被一个最底层的九品白役，一拳贯穿了胸膛。
四周死一般的寂静，只有暴雨砸在岩石上的“哗啦”声。
剩下的十二名精锐杀手看着冯远的尸体，大脑彻底陷入了宕机。连老大那刀枪不入的护体罡气都被一拳打爆了，他们这些杀手在这个怪物面前算什么？
“跑！他是披着人皮的怪物！快跑啊！”
十二名悍不畏死的杀手彻底崩溃，丢盔弃甲地朝着黑风谷的四面八方疯狂逃窜。
“跑？”
苏寒甩掉右手上沾染的鲜血。高达15点的精神力让这十二个人的逃跑路线在他的脑海中清晰得如同掌上观纹。
他脚下一踏，整个人犹如一头黑色的猎豹瞬间窜入雨幕之中。“砰！”一记《碎石拳》直轰后脑勺，跑得最快的杀手脑袋如同西瓜般炸裂开来。
“砰！砰！砰！”
凄厉的惨叫声在黑风谷中此起彼伏，但每一声惨叫都极短。苏寒化身成了一尊毫无感情的杀戮机器，每一拳都精准无误地命中目标的大脑。不打胸腹，不砍四肢，只爆头，绝对不留下活口。
不到半盏茶的功夫，二十名精锐杀手，整整齐齐地变成了没有脑袋的残破尸体。
苏寒踏着满地的血水，缓缓走回冯远的尸体旁。他蹲下身，双手熟练地在冯远沾满鲜血的锦缎长袍里摸索起来，摸出了三个被油布死死包裹的物件。
第一个油布包，是准备用来栽赃他的假账本。苏寒冷笑一声，真气透体而出，直接将其震成漫天碎纸屑，化作一滩烂泥。
第二个油布包，装着一枚古朴的玉简和一颗红色丹药：二流内功《血煞罡气》残篇和能瞬间恢复100点生命值的上品气血丹。
第三个油布包最厚重，里面是一沓大通钱庄全国通兑银票。五万两赃款！
苏寒将这笔巨款揣进怀里。心跳依然平稳，钱再多，也要有命花才行。
接下来，是极其繁琐的“背锅规划”。
苏寒站起身，捡起一把重达三十斤的精钢斩马刀。他没有用刀刃，而是握住刀背，将冯远的面部骨骼、牙齿，以及那二十名杀手残存的面部特征，全部砸成了肉泥。随后，粗暴地扒光了所有人身上带有“监事府”或“玄衣卫”标记的衣物。

他将二十一具尸体拖进半山腰一个废弃的老矿洞深处。这矿洞弥漫着高浓度的天然瓦斯，是完美的天然火药桶。
尸体扔进深坑，衣物盖在上面。苏寒退到矿洞入口，吹燃火折子，用力掷向矿洞深处瓦斯浓度最高的区域。
扔出火折子的瞬间，苏寒整个人犹如出膛的炮弹，贴着地面疯狂向后倒掠而出！
“轰隆——！！！”
一团极其恐怖的橘红色大火球猛烈炸开！高浓度的瓦斯爆炸产生了难以想象的破坏力，冲击波夹杂着烈焰吞没了整个矿洞。半山腰岩层彻底崩塌，成千上万吨的土石倾泻而下，将那废弃矿洞连同二十一具尸体深深掩埋。
就在这场惊天动地的掩埋完成的瞬间。视网膜上，系统光幕迎来了最疯狂的结算大爆！
【叮！您成功击杀目标：赤铁矿最高监事·冯远（高阶精英npc半步先天武者）！】
【由于您以基础武技越阶强杀高阶精英npc，达成‘以弱胜强’隐藏成就！】
【获得经验值：100，000点！】
【叮！您成功击杀精锐杀手x20！获得经验值总计：10，000点！】
【警告！经验槽严重溢出！】
【您的等级开始提升！】
【恭喜！您的等级提升至12级！】
【恭喜！您的等级提升至13级！】
【获得2点自由属性点！】
海量的经验值犹如倒灌的天河，在四肢百骸中疯狂冲刷。连升两级！原本释放底蕴升到11级的苏寒，瞬间跨越到了13级。丹田内的真气暴涨一倍有余，如同怒海狂潮。
“加点。”苏寒没有任何犹豫，将这无比珍贵的2点自由属性，再次全部砸进了精神面板。
【精神：15→17】
17点的精神力，让他的神识感知再次产生质的飞跃。他甚至能闭着眼睛，清晰地“看”到十米外草丛里，一只被雨水打湿翅膀的飞虫搓动触角的微小动作。
等级升了，赃款拿了，尸体毁了。现在，该回去“报案”了。

苏寒将崭新的官服在泥水里狠狠滚了两圈，用内力逼出几道触目惊心的瘀伤，逼得脸色煞白。随后，他跌跌撞撞地走上官道，朝着青叶城的方向奔去。
他的不在场证明完美无缺。

Feng Yuan's huge body collapsed suddenly, splashing blood and mud on the ground.
His eyes, which were wide open until death, were filled with incomprehensible shock and despair. The dignified Tu Emperor, who was half-step innate and powerful in the hematite mines for more than ten years, was punched through the chest by a ninth-grade white servant at the lowest level.
There was deathly silence all around, except for the sound of heavy rain hitting the rocks.
The remaining twelve elite killers looked at Feng Yuan's body, their brains completely shut down. Even the boss's invulnerable body-protecting aura was destroyed by one punch. What do these killers mean in front of this monster?
"Run! He is a monster in human skin! Run!"
The twelve killers who were not afraid of death completely collapsed, abandoning their armor and fleeing in all directions in the Black Wind Valley.
"Run?"
Su Han shook off the blood on his right hand. With up to 15 points of mental power, the escape routes of these twelve people were as clear in his mind as the lines on the palm of his hand.
As soon as he stepped on it, he instantly jumped into the rain like a black cheetah. "Bang!" A "Stone Punch" hit the back of the head, and the fastest killer's head exploded like a watermelon.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
Piercing screams echoed one after another in the Black Wind Valley, but each scream was extremely short. Su Han transformed into an emotionless killing machine, and every punch hit the target's brain accurately. No hits on the chest or abdomen, no limbs chopped off, just headshots, absolutely no one left alive.
In less than half a cup of tea, twenty elite killers were neatly transformed into mutilated corpses without heads.
Su Han stepped on the blood on the ground and slowly walked back to Feng Yuan's body. He squatted down, groped skillfully with his hands in Feng Yuan's blood-stained brocade robe, and found three objects tightly wrapped in oilcloth.
The first oilcloth bag was a fake account book prepared to frame him. Su Hanhan laughed, and his true energy came out of his body, directly shaking it into pieces of paper and turning it into a puddle of mud.
The second oilcloth bag contained an ancient jade slip and a red elixir: a fragment of the second-rate internal skill "Blood Evil Gang Qi" and a top-grade Qi and Blood elixir that could instantly restore 100 points of health.
The third oilcloth bag was the thickest, and inside was a stack of Chase Bank National Acceptance Banknotes. Fifty thousand taels of stolen money!
Su Han put this huge sum of money into his arms. The heartbeat is still steady. No matter how much money you have, you have to spend it with life.
Next, is the extremely cumbersome "taking the blame" plan.
Su Han stood up and picked up a stainless steel sword that weighed thirty kilograms. Instead of using the blade, he held the back of the knife and smashed Feng Yuan's facial bones, teeth, and the remaining facial features of the twenty killers into pulp. Afterwards, everyone was roughly stripped of their clothes marked with "Supervisor's Mansion" or "Xuan Yiwei".
He dragged twenty-one corpses deep into an old abandoned mine halfway up the mountain. This mine is filled with high concentrations of natural gas, making it a perfect natural powder keg.
The body was thrown into a pit and covered with clothing. Su Han retreated to the entrance of the mine, blew on the fire stick, and threw it hard towards the area with the highest gas concentration deep in the mine.
The moment he threw the fire stick, Su Han's whole body was like a cannonball, flying backwards against the ground crazily!
"Boom——!!!"
An extremely terrifying orange-red fireball exploded violently! The high-concentration gas explosion produced unimaginable destructive power, and the shock wave mixed with flames engulfed the entire mine. The rock formations halfway up the mountain collapsed completely, and tens of thousands of tons of earth and rocks poured down, deeply burying the abandoned mine and the twenty-one corpses.
At the moment when this earth-shattering burial was completed. On the retina, the system light curtain ushered in the craziest settlement explosion!
【bite! You successfully killed the target: Feng Yuan, the top supervisor of the hematite mine (a high-level elite NPC half-step innate warrior)! 】
[Because you used basic martial arts to cross levels and kill high-level elite NPCs,Achieve the hidden achievement of ‘defeat the strong with the weak’! 】
[Experience points gained: 100,000 points! 】
[Ding! You successfully killed the elite killer x20! Total experience points gained: 10,000 points! 】
【warn! The experience tank is seriously overflowing! 】
【Your level starts to increase! 】
【Congratulations! Your level has been increased to level 12! 】
【Congratulations! Your level has been increased to level 13! 】
[Get 2 free attribute points! 】
Massive amounts of experience points are like the Milky Way flowing backward, rushing through the limbs and corpses. Upgraded two levels in a row! Su Han, who had originally raised his level of release to level 11, instantly jumped to level 13. The true energy in Dantian more than doubled, like a furious sea tide.
"Add points." Su Han didn't hesitate at all, and smashed these two extremely precious points of free attributes into the mental panel again.
【Spirit: 15→17】
With 17 points of mental power, his spiritual perception once again made a qualitative leap. He could even close his eyes and clearly "see" the tiny movements of a flying insect with rain-wet wings rubbing its antennae in the grass ten meters away.
The level was increased, the stolen money was taken, and the body was destroyed. Now, it's time to go back and "report the crime."
Su Han rolled his brand-new official uniform twice in the muddy water, using his internal strength to force out several shocking bruises, which turned his face pale. Then, he stumbled onto the official road and ran towards Aoye Castle.
His alibi was impeccable.
